snippet.title: Venus: The Last Ascent - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the announcement trailer for Venus: The Last Ascent, a physics-based survival game where your base is a massive rolling fortress.
Build your machine, mine the surface of Venus, defend your reactors, and fight your way toward Cloud City.
The demo is live now on Steam. Play it, wishlist the game, and let us know what you think.

Play the demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2640150/Venus_The_Last_Ascent/

Follow Breaking Walls:
http://venusthelastascent.com/

#VenusTheLastAscent #indiegame #survivalgame #pcgaming #steamgames #gamedev
